title.en: Recognise skew, parallel and intersecting lines
Find the shortest distance between skew lines
Find the distance between parallel lines

say.en: Engineers building one road over another must know the least gap between them. For two skew lines this least gap is measured along the line perpendicular to both. In this lesson: Recognise skew, parallel and intersecting lines.
Find the shortest distance between skew lines.
Find the distance between parallel lines.

body.en: *Skew lines* are neither parallel nor intersecting; they do not lie in one plane. The shortest distance is the length of the common perpendicular. For $\vec r = \vec a_1 + \lambda\vec b_1$ and $\vec r = \vec a_2 + \mu\vec b_2$, it is the projection of $\vec a_2 - \vec a_1$ on $\vec b_1\times\vec b_2$.
body.kn: ಓರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಸಮಾಂತರವೂ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಛೇದಿಸುವುದೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ದೂರ = ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಲಂಬದ ಉದ್ದ = (a₂ − a₁) ನ b₁ × b₂ ಮೇಲಿನ ಪ್ರಕ್ಷೇಪ.

points.en: Shortest distance = 0 ⇔ the *lines* intersect (they are coplanar)
Direction of the common perpendicular: b₁⃗ × b₂⃗

narration.en: Skew lines neither meet nor run parallel. Their shortest distance is along the common perpendicular, whose direction is b one cross b two. So we project the vector joining the two given points onto b one cross b two.
narration.kn: ಓರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಸಮಾಂತರವೂ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಛೇದಿಸುವುದೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ದೂರ = ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಲಂಬದ ಉದ್ದ = (a₂ − a₁) ನ b₁ × b₂ ಮೇಲಿನ ಪ್ರಕ್ಷೇಪ.

blocks.formula: d = \left|\frac{(\vec b_1\times\vec b_2)\cdot(\vec a_2 - \vec a_1)}{|\vec b_1\times\vec b_2|}\right|

say.en: Skew lines neither meet nor run parallel. Their shortest distance is along the common perpendicular, whose direction is b one cross b two. So we project the vector joining the two given points onto b one cross b two. Shortest distance equals 0 if and only if the lines intersect they are coplanar.
say.kn: ಓರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಸಮಾಂತರವೂ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಛೇದಿಸುವುದೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ದೂರ equals ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಲಂಬದ ಉದ್ದ equals (a 2 - a 1) ನ b 1 times b 2 ಮೇಲಿನ ಪ್ರಕ್ಷೇಪ.

say.en: Direction of the common perpendicular: b 1⃗ times b 2⃗.

narration.en: The teacher draws two skew lines and their common perpendicular, then computes the shortest distance.

say.en: Skew lines are neither parallel nor intersecting. They lie in different planes, like a road and a bridge above it.
The shortest distance is along the common perpendicular P Q, which meets both lines at right angles.
Its direction is b1 cross b2. Project the join of the two points onto it.

draw.tex: d=\left|\frac{(\vec b_1\times\vec b_2)\cdot(\vec a_2-\vec a_1)}{|\vec b_1\times\vec b_2|}\right|

say.en: Example: b1 = 1, minus 1, 1 and b2 = 2, 1, 2. b1 cross b2 = minus 3, 0, 3. a2 minus a1 = 1, minus 3, minus 2.
The dot product is minus 9 and the length is 3 root 2. So d = 3 over root 2.
For parallel lines with the same b, use the cross product of b with a2 minus a1 instead.

narration.en: L₁ is the x-axis; L₂ passes through (1, 2, h) with direction (cos φ, sin φ, 0). They never meet. Slide P along L₁ and Q along L₂: the smallest |PQ| is the common perpendicular, |(a₂ − a₁)·(b₁ × b₂)| / |b₁ × b₂| = h.
narration.kn: L₁ x-ಅಕ್ಷ; L₂ (1, 2, h) ಮೂಲಕ, ದಿಕ್ಕು (cos φ, sin φ, 0). ಅವು ಸಂಧಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. P ಯನ್ನು L₁ ಮೇಲೆ, Q ಯನ್ನು L₂ ಮೇಲೆ ಸರಿಸಿ: ಕನಿಷ್ಠ |PQ| ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಲಂಬ, |(a₂ − a₁)·(b₁ × b₂)| / |b₁ × b₂| = h.

say.en: L 1 is the x-axis; L 2 passes through (1, 2, h) with direction (cos phi, sin phi, 0). They never meet. Slide P along L 1 and Q along L 2: the smallest |PQ| is the common perpendicular, |(a 2 - a 1) b 1 times b 2| / |b 1 times b 2| = h.
say.kn: L 1 x-ಅಕ್ಷ; L 2 (1, 2, h) ಮೂಲಕ, ದಿಕ್ಕು (cos phi, sin phi, 0). ಅವು ಸಂಧಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. P ಯನ್ನು L 1 ಮೇಲೆ, Q ಯನ್ನು L 2 ಮೇಲೆ ಸರಿಸಿ: ಕನಿಷ್ಠ |PQ| ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಲಂಬ, |(a 2 - a 1) b 1 times b 2| / |b 1 times b 2| = h.

body.en: If the lines are *parallel*, $\vec b_1 = \vec b_2 = \vec b$, so $\vec b_1\times\vec b_2 = \vec 0$ and the skew-line formula fails. Then the distance is $\frac{|\vec b\times(\vec a_2 - \vec a_1)|}{|\vec b|}$.
body.kn: ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಸಮಾಂತರವಾದರೆ b₁ × b₂ = 0, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಬೇರೆ ಸೂತ್ರ: d = |b × (a₂ − a₁)| / |b|.

narration.en: For parallel lines, b one cross b two is zero, so we need a different formula: the magnitude of b cross a two minus a one, divided by the magnitude of b.
narration.kn: ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಸಮಾಂತರವಾದರೆ b₁ × b₂ = 0, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಬೇರೆ ಸೂತ್ರ: d = |b × (a₂ − a₁)| / |b|.

say.en: For parallel lines, b one cross b two is zero, so we need a different formula: the magnitude of b cross a two minus a one, divided by the magnitude of b. Check for parallel directions first.
say.kn: ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಸಮಾಂತರವಾದರೆ b 1 times b 2 equals 0, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಬೇರೆ ಸೂತ್ರ: d = |b times (a 2 - a 1)| / |b|.

problem.en: Find the shortest distance between r⃗ = î + 2ĵ + k̂ + λ(î − ĵ + k̂) and r⃗ = 2î − ĵ − k̂ + μ(2î + ĵ + 2k̂).

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the shortest distance between r⃗ = î + 2ĵ + k̂ + λ(î − ĵ + k̂) and r⃗ = 2î − ĵ − k̂ + μ(2î + ĵ + 2k̂).

say.en: Let us solve this together. Find the shortest distance between r⃗ = î plus 2ĵ plus k̂ plus lambda (î - ĵ plus k̂) and r⃗ = 2î - ĵ - k̂ plus micro (2î plus ĵ plus 2k̂).
b 1⃗ times b 2⃗ = |î ĵ k̂; 1 minus 1 1; 2 1 2| = minus 3î plus 0ĵ plus 3k̂, magnitude 3 the square root of 2.
a 2⃗ - a 1⃗ = î minus 3ĵ minus 2k̂.
(b 1⃗ times b 2⃗) (a 2⃗ - a 1⃗) equals minus 3 plus 0 minus 6 equals minus 9.
d = |-9|/3 the square root of 2 equals 3/ the square root of 2 equals 3 the square root of 2 over 2.
So the answer is 3 the square root of 2 over 2 units.

problem.en: Find the distance between the parallel lines r⃗ = î + 2ĵ − 4k̂ + λ(2î + 3ĵ + 6k̂) and r⃗ = 3î + 3ĵ − 5k̂ + μ(2î + 3ĵ + 6k̂).

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the distance between the parallel lines r⃗ = î + 2ĵ − 4k̂ + λ(2î + 3ĵ + 6k̂) and r⃗ = 3î + 3ĵ − 5k̂ + μ(2î + 3ĵ + 6k̂).

say.en: Let us solve this together. Find the distance between the parallel lines r⃗ = î plus 2ĵ minus 4k̂ plus lambda (2î plus 3ĵ plus 6k̂) and r⃗ = 3î plus 3ĵ minus 5k̂ plus micro (2î plus 3ĵ plus 6k̂).
b⃗ = 2î plus 3ĵ plus 6k̂, |b⃗| = 7; a 2⃗ - a 1⃗ = 2î plus ĵ - k̂.
b⃗ times (a 2⃗ - a 1⃗) equals minus 9î plus 14ĵ minus 4k̂, magnitude the square root of 81 plus 196 plus 16 equals the square root of 293.
d equals the square root of 293 over 7.
So the answer is the square root of 293 over 7 units.

body.en: For skew lines the numerator (b₁⃗ × b₂⃗)·(a₂⃗ − a₁⃗) is a 3 × 3 determinant: rows a₂ − a₁, b₁ and b₂. So d = |determinant| / |b₁⃗ × b₂⃗|. If the determinant is 0, the lines intersect.

narration.en: Box over cross. For skew lines the numerator (b₁⃗ × b₂⃗)·(a₂⃗ − a₁⃗) is a 3 × 3 determinant: rows a₂ − a₁, b₁ and b₂. So d = |determinant| / |b₁⃗ × b₂⃗|. If the determinant is 0, the lines intersect.

say.en: Box over cross. For skew lines the numerator (b 1⃗ times b 2⃗) (a 2⃗ - a 1⃗) is a 3 times 3 determinant: rows a 2 - a 1, b 1 and b 2. So d = |determinant| / |b 1⃗ times b 2⃗|. If the determinant is 0, the lines intersect.

points.kn: ಓರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಸಮಾಂತರವೂ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಛೇದಿಸುವುದೂ ಇಲ್ಲ.

points.en: Skew lines: d = |(b₁⃗ × b₂⃗)·(a₂⃗ − a₁⃗)| / |b₁⃗ × b₂⃗|.
points.kn: ಓರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು: d = |(b₁ × b₂)·(a₂ − a₁)| / |b₁ × b₂|.

points.en: Shortest distance zero means the lines intersect.

narration.en: Recap. Skew lines are neither parallel nor intersecting. Skew lines: d = |(b₁⃗ × b₂⃗)·(a₂⃗ − a₁⃗)| / |b₁⃗ × b₂⃗|. Parallel lines: d = |b⃗ × (a₂⃗ − a₁⃗)| / |b⃗|. Shortest distance zero means the lines intersect.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಓರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಸಮಾಂತರವೂ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಛೇದಿಸುವುದೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಓರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು: d = |(b₁ × b₂)·(a₂ − a₁)| / |b₁ × b₂|. ಸಮಾಂತರ ರೇಖೆಗಳು: d = |b × (a₂ − a₁)| / |b|. ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ದೂರ ಶೂನ್ಯವಾದರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಛೇದಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. Skew lines are neither parallel nor intersecting.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಓರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಸಮಾಂತರವೂ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಛೇದಿಸುವುದೂ ಇಲ್ಲ.

say.en: Skew lines: d = |(b 1⃗ times b 2⃗) (a 2⃗ - a 1⃗)| / |b 1⃗ times b 2⃗|.
say.kn: ಓರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು: d = |b 1 times b 2 (a 2 - a 1)| / |b 1 times b 2|.

say.en: Parallel lines: d = |b⃗ times (a 2⃗ - a 1⃗)| / |b⃗|.
Shortest distance zero means the lines intersect.
